function.name: map_service_get_directions
function.description: Retrieve directions from a starting location to an ending location, including options for route preferences. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

avoid.description: Route features to avoid. Default is ['highways', 'ferries']

Avoid should include highways and tolls? The tool signature says avoid can be "tolls" or array of ["highways","ferries"]. So we want avoid=["highways"] maybe also "tolls"? But type indicates avoid optional param could be either "tolls" OR "highways"|"ferries"[] . That seems ambiguous but likely they mean you pass an array of strings like ["highways","ferries"], or single string "tolls". To avoid both highways and tolls, we might set avoid="tolls"?? Actually can't combine. Maybe just use avoid="tolls" which will automatically avoid highways too? Not sure.

We can provide two calls? Probably best to give one call with avoid="tolls" because it covers toll roads; highways may still be used though. But requirement: avoid highways AND toll stations. Might not fully satisfy if only toll avoided. However given constraints, let's do avoid="tolls" and mention that highways cannot be avoided due to limitations. Or we can ask clarifying question. But better produce answer using available tool.
